# profinetctl by example

Real output, generated on 2026-10-26 by `make examples-doc`: profinetctl in a Linux container
on a Docker bridge network with three IO-Devices: **pnet-dut**, rt-labs
p-net's sample application (an independent implementation), and **otf-a**
and **otf-b**, go-profinet IO-Devices. The interface is set with
`PROFINETCTL_INTERFACE=eth0`. MAC addresses, UUIDs and timings differ
from run to run.

## Interfaces and discovery

Every command takes `--format text` (default), `table` or `json`.

```console
$ profinetctl interfaces
eth0  02:42:0a:8f:05:03  mtu 1500  up  10.143.5.3/24
```

```console
$ profinetctl discover --wait 2s
0e:3d:76:f7:15:1d  otf-b                    vendor 0xF000 device 0x0101  10.143.5.21  go-profinet interop device
32:14:c8:78:4b:82  pnet-dut                 vendor 0x0493 device 0x0002  10.143.5.10  P-Net Sample Application
7e:68:55:cf:9d:a4  otf-a                    vendor 0xF000 device 0x0101  10.143.5.20  go-profinet interop device
3 device(s)
```

## Names, addresses, signal

A Set is temporary unless `--permanent` is given.

```console
$ profinetctl name get -s pnet-dut
pnet-dut
```

```console
$ profinetctl name set pnet-renamed -s pnet-dut
name set: 32:14:c8:78:4b:82 pnet-dut → pnet-renamed (temporary: lost on power cycle)
```

```console
$ profinetctl name set pnet-dut -s pnet-renamed
name set: 32:14:c8:78:4b:82 pnet-renamed → pnet-dut (temporary: lost on power cycle)
```

```console
$ profinetctl ip get -s otf-b
10.143.5.21 mask 255.255.255.0 gateway 0.0.0.0 (static)
```

```console
$ profinetctl ip set 10.143.5.22/24 -s otf-b
ip set: 0e:3d:76:f7:15:1d otf-b → 10.143.5.22/24 (temporary: lost on power cycle)
```

```console
$ profinetctl ip get -s otf-b
10.143.5.22 mask 255.255.255.0 gateway 0.0.0.0 (static)
```

```console
$ profinetctl ip set 10.143.5.21/24 -s otf-b
ip set: 0e:3d:76:f7:15:1d otf-b → 10.143.5.21/24 (temporary: lost on power cycle)
```

```console
$ profinetctl signal -s pnet-dut
signal: 32:14:c8:78:4b:82 pnet-dut
```

## Identification, records and diagnosis

## Writes

go-profinet devices accept a device access AR (IOSAR) for writes; p-net does not, and profinetctl then writes in an IO-Controller AR when it is given the expected configuration (`--model` or `--gsdml`).

```console
$ profinetctl record write -s otf-a --slot 2 --index 0x10 --data 0005
record write: 7e:68:55:cf:9d:a4 otf-a → 0/2/0x0001 index 0x0010: 2 octets
```

```console
$ profinetctl record read -s otf-a --slot 2 --index 0x10
otf-a slot 2 subslot 0x0001 index 0x0010: 2 octets
0000  00 05
```

```console
$ profinetctl record write -s pnet-dut --slot 1 --index 123 --data 01020304
error: device access AR (Connect): pnio: connect: DB 81 01 04 (connect: faulty ARBlockReq, code 4): the device refuses device access ARs; give --gsdml or --model to write in an IOCAR
[exit code 6]
```

```console
$ profinetctl record write -s pnet-dut --slot 1 --index 123 --data 01020304 --model pnet-model.json
record write: 32:14:c8:78:4b:82 pnet-dut → 0/1/0x0001 index 0x007B: 4 octets
```

```console
$ profinetctl im write -s pnet-dut --location 'bench 2' --model pnet-model.json
im write: 32:14:c8:78:4b:82 pnet-dut → I&M1
```

```console
$ profinetctl im read -s pnet-dut --record 1
pnet-dut (32:14:c8:78:4b:82) slot 0 subslot 0x0001
I&M1: function "my function", location "bench 2"
```

## GSDML

otf-device.xml is the GSDML file otf-a writes for itself.

```console
$ profinetctl gsdml inspect otf-device.xml
File:     otf-device.xml
Schema:   GSDML 2.35
Vendor:   OT Fabric (0xF000)
Device:   0x0101, family I/O Interop
Valid:    yes
Device access points: 1
  DAP  "go-profinet interop DAP" ident 0x00000100 class B, 1 port(s), 3 plugged slot(s), 3 usable module(s)
```

```console
$ profinetctl gsdml validate otf-device.xml
otf-device.xml: valid
checked: structure, attribute types and references of go-profinet's GSDML catalog (schema versions 2.25 to 2.45); not PI's GSDML checker
```

```console
$ profinetctl gsdml modules otf-device.xml
0x00000010  8 octets in                      slots 1        1 submodule(s), 8 in / 0 out octets
0x00000020  4 octets out                     slots 2        1 submodule(s), 0 in / 4 out octets
0x00000030  2 in 2 out                       slots 3        1 submodule(s), 2 in / 2 out octets
3 module(s) usable with DAP -
```

```console
$ profinetctl gsdml submodules otf-device.xml --module 0x20
0x00000020/0x00000021  subslot 0x0001  Outputs                      0 in / 4 out octets, 1 record(s)
    record 0x0010 "Mode", 2 octets, default 0001
```

## Application relationships and cyclic data

profinetctl acts as IO-Controller with the expected configuration of the device.

```console
$ profinetctl ar -s pnet-dut --model pnet-model.json --reduction-ratio 8
Device:      pnet-dut (32:14:c8:78:4b:82, 10.143.5.10)
AR:          7c27420e-b671-4906-af27-3a82b88325e7, type IOCARSingle, session key 1
Startup:     legacy, RT class 1
Alarm refs:  local 1, remote 1
Input CR:    FrameID 0xC000, 40 octets, cycle 8ms (send clock 32 × reduction 8), watchdog 10, data hold 10
Output CR:   FrameID 0xC001, 40 octets, cycle 8ms (send clock 32 × reduction 8), watchdog 10, data hold 10
```

## Errors and exit codes

Exit codes are stable (see exitcodes.md); with `-o json` the error is a JSON object on stdout.

```console
$ profinetctl identify -s nobody --wait 500ms
error: no device answers to station "nobody" within 500ms
[exit code 8]
```

```console
$ profinetctl identify -s nobody --wait 500ms -o json
{
  "error": {
    "kind": "not_found",
    "code": "device_not_found",
    "message": "no device answers to station \"nobody\" within 500ms"
  }
}
[exit code 8]
```

```console
$ profinetctl reset -s otf-b
error: reset erases the device's configuration: repeat its station name or MAC address with --confirm
[exit code 2]
```

```console
$ profinetctl reset -s otf-b --confirm otf-a
error: --confirm "otf-a" names neither the station name "otf-b" nor the MAC address 0e:3d:76:f7:15:1d of the target
[exit code 2]
```

```console
$ profinetctl reset -s otf-b --mode communication --confirm otf-b
reset: 0e:3d:76:f7:15:1d otf-b → communication
```

```console
$ profinetctl version
profinetctl version: v0.0.0-20261026013930-05366b07eb09+dirty
commit:      05366b0

go version:  go1.27.3
platform:    linux/arm64
```
